# 1 Enoch Chapter 105 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**1** My son and I will walk with them forever, side by side, on the paths of righteousness through all the days of their lives. You will have peace. Celebrate, children of righteousness. Amen.

**2** [Secondary variant: And now I speak to you, sons of men: love wisdom and understanding in every generation; walk in the ways of all my creation. God has set an end for all things, and what has been placed in your hearts will be fulfilled. You will rejoice and have plenty. Love God and he will guard you. Your hearts will be strengthened and your mouths will overflow with praise. And a parable from the Holy and Great One is shown to you.]

---

*PNEUMA notes: V. 1 closes the Epistle with extraordinary warmth: Enoch himself will walk the paths of righteousness alongside the children of righteousness, forever. It is a personal promise of companionship — not just eschatological vindication but eternal relationship. The "Amen" seals it as a liturgical act. The chapter is short precisely because the Epistle is complete. What follows (chs. 106–108) is an appendix.*
